task.description:
WF-02, step 1 — write the design of REQ-105 (end-to-end tests of the solution picker site in a real headless Chrome) in docs/design/REQ-105-e2e-picker.md, by the section "Step 1" of docs/workflows/WF-02-development.md. No implementation code in the design: shapes, signatures, tables only.

READ FIRST: the block REQ-105 in docs/requirements.yaml (all 9 criteria; read by id, the file is large); docs/design/REQ-104-e2e-chrome-kit.md (the kit API and section 21 "As built" — the code in tools/test/e2e/kit/ is the truth, read it too); decisions/0107, decisions/0108 (O1 and the addenda), decisions/0023 (D2); docs/quality-bar.md; docs/anti-patterns.md (especially AP-140..AP-144); the README sections "The solution picker site" and tools/src/picker/ (cli.js serve, public/*.js, demo-tenants, demo-tenants-v3, demo-answers, demo-answers-v3); tools/test/e2e/smoke.e2e.js as the model of a spec file; docs/issues/ISS-0100, ISS-0102, ISS-0103, ISS-0104.

WHAT THE DESIGN MUST SETTLE: (1) the server starter tools/test/e2e/kit/stand.js that REQ-104 left to this run (spawn node src/picker/cli.js serve with --port 0, read the link from stdout, stop with SIGTERM and require exit code 0, keep stderr, refuse a state folder outside the temporary root with assertUnderTempRoot, clean up on every path including a killed runner, a free stand-in for the tests of the starter itself, and how REQ-106 and REQ-107 will reuse it); (2) the structure of tools/test/e2e/picker.e2e.js: eight tests for the eight page criteria and the one time/independence criterion, with the helper table for the 18-combination matrix, the coverage table of criterion 2, the WCAG contrast formula with its two controls, the raw HTTP request for /t/%2e%2e/, the declared console lines (favicon once per start, the 404 line of each of four page loads); (3) a time budget: criterion 9 says 80000 ms at most, and the GitHub runner was about 2 times slower than the developer machine for the smoke file (17 s here, 35 s there) — state how the design keeps the file under the limit on the runner (one browser per test or one for all, reuse of tabs, parallel stands), measured with a sketch, and do not take a timing from one machine as a fact for the other (ISS-0103); (4) the kit calls that already exist and any missing kit call (list it as a change of the kit with its own tests, not a silent edit); (5) the replacement table of earlier guard tests (search tools/test/ for scans that read the folder tools/test/e2e or count files; the requirement says none, check it on the tag) and the shared places (README table row made by REQ-104, tools/package.json if the runner selects files by name); (6) criterion 7 of REQ-104 left open in ISS-0102: with picker.e2e.js and smoke.e2e.js there are now two real spec files, so state how the order check on two real files is run by the validator.

Check every statement about the current system with a sketch outside the project (a fresh clone of the tag base/E2E105-20261105-01, npm ci, then dummy files) and write the command, the output and the date. The text of tasks and the design must hold no absolute machine paths and no names of other projects of the owner (traces and handoffs-check fail on them). Mutants: at least 20, each with the test that catches it. The section about the bar: Q1-Q14 and R1-R3, each "applicable: how" or "not applicable: why". Open questions go as a list O1, O2, … with a default, not settled by a guess.

issues.text: The block REQ-105 has ten acceptance criteria (matrix, pass, themes, keyboard, storage, isolation, not found, no connection, v3, time and independence), the handoff says nine and 'eight tests'. The design has nine tests for criteria 1-9 and criterion 10 by command and by the scans (O1). Checked: awk over the block, 10 lines '- >-'.

Criterion 1 says the h1 equals the tenant 'title' of GET .../api/questionnaire; the answer has the field `name` and no `title` (the tenant file has name per language). The design uses `name` and the tenant file's name[lang] (O2).

Criterion 1 'the start button lies inside the window': at 320x568 in Russian its bottom is 594 > 568 while there is no horizontal overflow (measured). The design asserts horizontal containment and that the whole rectangle is inside the window after scrolling it into view; the vertical reading would fail on a correct page (O3).

Criterion 8 says the kit reports no console error; every failed fetch writes one browser line 'Failed to load resource: net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED' (two for two presses) and the kit fails an undeclared one. The design declares that exact line with its path and asserts exactly two entries (O4). The criterion text needs the same declaration (micro-amendment of WF-01 or an as-built note).

Criterion 4 'reaches restart of the card' with keys only: the card has 'restart' only after a reload with something saved, and no key path leads from a question back to the card. The design reloads once with the kit (a protocol call, no input event) (O5).

The block says 'Guard tests of earlier requirements, was -> became: none'. Measured on a clone of the tag with all new files: of 2188 tests one is red, E2K-50 (the files that may read the environment / the variable names), and E2K-41 and E2K-60 need two small word additions; all three are in tools/test/e2e-kit.test.js; no other guard test is touched (section 12, O9, O10).
O6 (ORCH): the starter stand.js has no criterion in REQ-105; its 20 tests E2S-01..20 are listed as supporting tests under criteria 7, 8 and 10. Alternative: a criterion 11 by a WF-01 micro-amendment.

O7 (ORCH): the runner's list of browsers is fed with a marker folder made by makeTempDir('profile') so that cleanup.js does not change (a blocked-event-loop spec still loses its stand: measured). Alternative: rename the shape in cleanup.js (small change of a released file).

O8 (ORCH): proposal for decisions/0109-e2e-stand-conventions.md with the section 'Basis' (Q12): the short environment list for a stand, detached + registered + marker, exit code 0 required on stop, the five new error codes, the fixtures folder tools/test/fixtures/e2e-stand, the base list names.

O10 (ORCH): E2K-50 - read the base environment list by named properties (six names added to ENV_NAMES, default) or by one whole-environment read in stand.js (the allowlist of files that read the whole object grows from three to four).

O11 (ORCH): the spec does not assert its own run time (a timing assertion is a flaky test, AP-144); RELEASE-VALIDATOR reads duration_ms of the e2e step in the GitHub run of the release and stops with a question above 48000 ms (60 percent of the limit). The runner time for this file is an estimate (33-52 s), not a measurement: no push was allowed.

O3/O5/O9 defaults are written in section 19 of the design with the cost of the other choice; O12: the Q13 items (armed stop timer kept the spec alive 10 s; 'inside the window' read both ways; the console line of a failing request; saved state at the second pass on one origin) are for DOC-UPDATER to put into docs/anti-patterns.md - this run's write set is the design only.

The statement in the task that the GitHub runner took about 35 s for the smoke file: the release reports give two readings, 25539 ms (run 41678354227) and 34821 ms (the run on main after ISS-0103), against 17462 ms here. Both are used in section 7; neither is taken as a fact for picker.e2e.js.

ISS-0102 item 2 (order of spec files on two real files) was run on the prototype: 'e2e -- smoke picker' prints smoke, picker; the reverse prints picker, smoke; the alphabetical order differs from 'last to first' for the first time. The procedure for the validator is section 13.
